video_title: Karl-Anthony Towns, Josh Hart, Jose Alvarado Postgame Media | November 22, 2026

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the team's need for consistent 48-minute effort
quotes.excerpt: we still haven't consistently played 48 minutes. Even tonight, we did a good job getting a lead
quotes.quote: I think we are doing a good job, but we still haven't consistently played 48 minutes. Even tonight, we did a good job getting a lead and protecting the lead and then we let go of the rope in the fourth and gave life to the other team. We have to do a better job on that with the consistency and the effort for 48 minutes and execution.
quotes.social_post: Karl-Anthony Towns says the Knicks still struggle with consistency. He noted that even in tonight's win, the team let go of the rope in the fourth quarter and gave life to the opponent.

structured.context: Karl-Anthony Towns discusses the team's struggle to maintain consistent effort for the full 48 minutes of a game.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on Jose Alvarado's dangerous offensive performance
quotes.excerpt: when he's bringing his whole arsenal to the game, he's a dangerous player for any team
quotes.quote: Every person on the other team would tell you the same thing. He's a pest. Obviously, you see him shooting the ball really well these last two games. When he's bringing his whole arsenal to the game, he's a dangerous player for any team.
quotes.social_post: Karl-Anthony Towns on Jose Alvarado: Every person on the other team would tell you the same thing. He is a pest. When he is bringing his whole arsenal to the game, he is a dangerous player for any team.

structured.context: Karl-Anthony Towns praises Jose Alvarado for his recent offensive performance and his reputation as a disruptive defender.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the team's need to build better championship habits
quotes.excerpt: we can't wait for the playoffs to have that switch turned on. We have to work on our habits
quotes.quote: I just think that we let our foot off the gas. That's not what we need to be doing. We need to be building a better habit and better mentality when it comes to having a lead and protecting a lead. That's what made us so special in the playoffs. We can't wait for the playoffs to have that switch turned on. We have to work on our habits now so we can build those championship habits.
quotes.social_post: Karl-Anthony Towns says the Knicks cannot wait for the playoffs to turn on their championship habits. He emphasized that the team needs to stop letting their foot off the gas when they have a lead.

structured.context: Karl-Anthony Towns emphasizes the importance of building championship habits during the regular season rather than waiting for the playoffs.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on the team's improved attention to detail and execution
quotes.excerpt: some of it is just the attention to detail. I don't think it was bad early on
quotes.quote: I think some of it is just the attention to detail. I don't think it was bad early on. We were losing one or two possession games. It's not like we were getting blown out. It was just a play here or there with the lack of execution that caught up to us. I think now we are putting those possessions together and getting back into the flow of the game.
quotes.social_post: Josh Hart says the Knicks' recent improvement comes down to attention to detail. He noted that early season losses were just a play here or there, and now they are finally putting those possessions together.

structured.context: Josh Hart reflects on the team's improved attention to detail and execution in recent games.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on the need to execute better and run late in close games
quotes.excerpt: I think we have to run more late. That's an easy way to relieve some of that pressure
quotes.quote: I think we have to execute better. I think we have to run more late. That's an easy way to relieve some of that pressure. You saw I think Karl had the one layup with a minute and a half left. That was a big one for us. So we just have to continue to run, generate good shots like that, and then when we get into the half-court offense, execute.
quotes.social_post: Josh Hart says the key for the Knicks in late game situations is to run more to relieve pressure and then execute in the half court.

structured.context: Josh Hart discusses the need for better execution and transition offense in the final minutes of close games.

quotes.speaker: Jose Alvarado
quotes.summary_phrase: Jose Alvarado on the team's need to pay attention to details for full games
quotes.excerpt: we just got to be pay attention for more details. We got to finish the whole game
quotes.quote: We just got to be pay attention for more details. We got to finish the whole game, don't play half a game and that's on us.
quotes.social_post: Jose Alvarado says the team needs to focus on playing a full game instead of just half a game.

structured.context: Jose Alvarado comments on the team's need to maintain focus and finish games strong.

quotes.speaker: Jose Alvarado
quotes.summary_phrase: Jose Alvarado on the team's aggressive approach to the game
quotes.excerpt: we came out more aggressive. We pay attention more details and we took out their strength
quotes.quote: We came out more aggressive. We pay attention more details and we took out their strength. We know they like to be on the fast break, we know they like to be physical and we try to match that right away.
quotes.social_post: Jose Alvarado on the team's approach: We came out more aggressive. We pay attention more details and we took out their strength. We know they like to be on the fast break and we try to match that right away.

structured.context: Jose Alvarado explains the team's strategy to match the opponent's physicality and limit their fast-break opportunities.
